subject: science
concept: Understanding Earth's major layers (crust, mantle, core) at a basic level
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Systems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple layered model (like a cut fruit) representing Earth's crust, mantle, and core
exercise.pictorial: Student labels Earth's layers on a cross-section diagram
exercise.abstract: Student describes one basic feature of a named Earth layer

misconception_flags: confuses the order or relative size of Earth's layers

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
